title: Actual sheaf dg submodules and their total section set
statement: Fix one of the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site, $S$ a sheaf of commutative rings, $A$ a sheaf dg $S$-algebra and $M$ a left sheaf dg $A$-module as in [def-sfb-sheaf-dg-module-localization], with section sets in the fixed universe. A dg subsheaf $N$ of $M$ is a family $N^q$ of actual module-subsheaf codes of $M^q$ [def-sfb-small-site-module-subsheaf-codes], indexed by $q\in\mathbf Z$, such that $d_M(N^q(U))\subseteq N^{q+1}(U)$ and $A^p(U)N^q(U)\subseteq N^{p+q}(U)$ for every object $U$ and integers $p,q$. Thus the module operations, restrictions, differential and action are inherited from $M$, and the code requires the sheaf axiom in every degree. Inclusion $F\subseteq G$ means $F^q(U)\subseteq G^q(U)$ for every $q,U$. Its total section set is $\coprod_{U\in\mathcal C,q\in\mathbf Z}N^q(U)$, retaining the object and degree labels.
